summary: This upgrade has no intended user-visible change, so these frames prove the Perps flows still render and compute correctly on controller v11 — they are not a before/after comparison.

standalone.label: Order submitted toast after placing a real ETH order
standalone.note: The one user-visible surface this diff touches: the toast is emitted by PerpsToastOptions.orderManagement[getTriggerExecution(orderForm.type)].submitted(...), the controller helper that replaces the old direct index.

standalone.label: Limit order form with live limit price and computed fee
standalone.note: Limit order type selected at the recipe's $10 notional, with the limit price and a non-zero fee both populated — the fee hook running on the widened OrderType. Live mark-derived figures are deliberately not quoted here: they change on every run.

standalone.label: Auto close sheet with take profit and stop loss applied to an open position
standalone.note: Take profit at the +25% preset and stop loss at the -10% preset, each with its trigger price and expected profit/loss populated, through the widened usePerpsTPSLForm. Live mark-derived figures are deliberately not quoted here: they change on every run.

standalone.label: Close position sheet at 100% with fees and receive amount
standalone.note: A 100% Market close with margin, fee and receive amount populated. Exercises v11's reduce-only size-grid rounding through the widened usePerpsClosePosition.

videos.note: screenshots preferred; video parked for mirror
